subjective: Patient reports sore throat and fever since yesterday, painful swallowing, mild body aches. No cough or runny nose.
objective: Throat erythematous with white patches on tonsils. Temperature 100.9 F.
assessment: Findings consistent with streptococcal pharyngitis (strep throat).
plan: Start amoxicillin. Advise fluids and rest. Return if not improved in 3 days or if symptoms worsen.
